introduction: Washington’s Working Families Tax Credit refunds qualifying sales or use tax. Apply separately from the federal tax return.
description: Washington’s Working Families Tax Credit refunds qualifying sales or use tax. Apply separately from the federal tax return.

sections.who: Rules include 183 days in Washington, an SSN or ITIN, federal-return filing and EITC eligibility or the equivalent ITIN rules. Applicants must be at least 25 and under 65 or have a qualifying child.
sections.get: The refund depends on the tax year, income and qualifying children. Use that year’s instructions.
sections.docs:
• Entire federal tax return.
  • Identification, household and residence evidence requested by Revenue.
sections.apply:
1. Complete federal filing

    Determine eligibility for the matching tax year.

  2. Apply

    Use MyDOR or a paper form from WFTC Apply.

  3. Attach the return

    Include the entire federal return and save submission details.
sections.after: Do not submit duplicates. Check the application status and answer Revenue’s requests.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current eligibility; WFTC application; 2025 application instructions. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Yes, subject to the program’s eligibility rules.
Is federal filing the whole application?
No. WFTC requires its own application.
Is only the first return page enough?
Revenue requires the entire federal return.
Should I reapply if processing is slow?
Do not submit a duplicate application.
